AI Strategy · 6 min read

Where AI actually saves a small business time

AI is most useful when it removes repetitive work, improves the quality of a first draft, or helps you see patterns faster. It should support judgment—not replace it.

Start with a bottleneck, not a tool.
Choose one task that repeats every week and takes more time than it should. Improve that workflow before adding another platform.

Five practical starting points

  1. Customer research: group survey or review feedback into recurring questions and themes.
  2. Content planning: turn customer questions into a useful monthly topic map.
  3. First drafts: create outlines for emails, posts, and landing pages—then add your expertise.
  4. Repurposing: adapt one strong idea into multiple formats without copying it word for word.
  5. Performance review: summarize channel data so you can spot what deserves closer attention.

The guardrails matter: check facts, protect sensitive information, and make sure the final work sounds like your business. The advantage is not “more content.” It is faster learning and more consistent execution.

Marketing Plan · 5 min read

A simple 90-day digital marketing plan

Divide the quarter into three jobs. In the first 30 days, clarify your audience, offer, and conversion goal. In the next 30, build a consistent content and follow-up rhythm. In the final 30, review what created meaningful conversations or sales and improve that path.

Keep one primary measure for the quarter.
Examples include qualified consultation requests, repeat purchases, or sales conversations—not just reach.
Content · 4 min read

Create content that supports sales

Useful content answers the questions people ask before they are ready to buy. Build your topics around three stages: understanding the problem, comparing possible approaches, and feeling confident about the next step.

A balanced content system teaches, proves your thinking, and invites action. Each piece does not need to sell, but the overall journey should make the value of working with you easy to understand.
